This approach provides creators with full ownership and control over their sales process, as well as the ability to reach customers in regions where traditional payment platforms are not available. How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture of sovereign commerce infrastructure is based on a combination of free and paid tools, including GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, and Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage. This stack is designed to provide a scalable and secure platform for creators to sell their digital products, with automatic crypto payment processing and instant product delivery. By using a decentralized approach, creators can avoid the restrictions and fees associated with traditional payment platforms.
Who This Is Built For and Why

Sovereign commerce infrastructure is built for digital creators who are looking for a reliable and flexible way to sell their products online, without being limited by the restrictions of traditional payment platforms. This includes creators in regions where PayPal and Stripe are not available, as well as those who want to maintain full control over their sales process and customer data. By providing a decentralized and blockchain-based solution, sovereign commerce infrastructure can help creators to reach a global audience and monetize their content in a way that is both secure and efficient.

The Components That Make It Work Together

By integrating these components, creators can build a seamless and secure sales process that is both scalable and reliable.
